title: Convolutional Encoder
source_docs: Communications Toolbox HDL Support/Error Detection and Correction/Convolutional/Convolutional_Encoder.md
Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/Convolutional_Encoder.md
text: Encode binary data using convolutional encoding scheme, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Operation mode} sets Termination method of encoded frame; {Trellis structure}, {numInputSymbols} sets the number, {numOutputSymbols} sets the number, {numStates} sets the number, {nextStates}, {outputs}, {Delay reset action to next time step} sets the option, {Specify initial state via input port} sets the option, {Output final state} sets the option, {Puncture code} sets the option and {Puncture vector} sets the puncture pattern 1; 0; 1.

ports.name: ISt
ports.summary: Initial state of encoder registers nonnegative integer

ports.name: Rst
ports.summary: Reset state of encoder registers scalar

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Convolutionally encoded codeword binary column vector

ports.name: FSt
ports.summary: Final state of encoder registers nonnegative integer

params.name: Trellis structure
params.values: Trellis description of convolutional code poly2trellis(7, [171 133]) (default)

params.name: numInputSymbols
params.values: Number of symbols input to encoder 2 K

params.name: numOutputSymbols
params.values: Number of symbols output from encoder 2 N

params.name: numStates
params.values: Number of states in encoder power of 2

params.name: Operation mode
params.values: Termination method of encoded frame Continuous (default) | Truncated (reset every frame) | Terminate trellis by appending bits | Reset on nonzero input via port

params.name: Delay reset action to next time step
params.values: Option to delay reset action until next time step off (default) | on

params.name: Specify initial state via input port
params.values: Option to specify initial state via input port off (default) | on

params.name: Output final state
params.values: Option to output final register state off (default) | on

params.name: Puncture code
params.values: Option to enable the code puncturing off (default) | on
